businesses.business: metal coating services and infrastructure solutions

offering_description.value: Provides hot-dip galvanizing and other metal coating services that protect fabricated steel from corrosion, plus coil coating of steel and aluminum. Customers are fabricators, manufacturers and contractors in construction, infrastructure, utilities and industrial markets. Services are delivered at a network of plants in North America.

primary_products.value: coated steel and aluminum coil; precision coated metal products

primary_services.value: hot-dip galvanizing; coil coating; powder coating and other applied coatings; inspection and engineering support

customer_segment.value: B2B: steel fabricators, electrical transmission and utility contractors, manufacturers, building products and appliance makers; B2G: public infrastructure projects such as highways and bridges via contractors

end_markets.value: infrastructure; electrical transmission and utilities; construction; industrial; appliances and building products

revenue_model.value: service fees: galvanizing and coating of customer-owned steel, priced by weight or volume; product sales: coated coil sold to manufacturers

value_chain_position.value: service provider: applies protective zinc and other coatings to customer-supplied fabricated steel; OEM / manufacturer: coats purchased steel and aluminum coil for sale to manufacturers

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with plants across many US states

specialization.value: related lines: galvanizing, coil coating and related precoating services for metal

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving fabricators, contractors, utilities and coil customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, air emissions, zinc handling and workplace safety rules from EPA and OSHA
